paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioGPT and Llama2, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioGPT and Llama2. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," has a logarithmic scale, ranges from approximately 1 to 10^3, and has tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC(%)", is linear, ranges from 60 to 80, and has tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. The plot contains six lines: Base (black, circle markers, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond markers, solid line), FT (blue, triangle markers, solid line), MEMIT (purple, plus markers, solid line), IKE (red, triangle markers, solid line), and ROME (green, square markers, solid line). Starting from the left, the Base line begins at approximately 61.5 ACC(%) at a Co-occurrence Number of 1 and increases steadily to around 67.5 ACC(%) at a Co-occurrence Number of 10^3. The MEND line starts at around 69 ACC(%) and increases to about 77 ACC(%). The FT line begins at approximately 64.5 ACC(%) and increases to around 71 ACC(%). The MEMIT line starts at around 68.5 ACC(%) and increases to about 75 ACC(%). The IKE line begins at approximately 65 ACC(%) and increases to around 72.5 ACC(%). The ROME line starts at around 74 ACC(%) and increases to about 82 ACC(%).
